title: Add GET /api/products/low-stock endpoint with configurable threshold
description: As a warehouse manager, I want a dedicated API endpoint to retrieve all products with stock below a configurable threshold so that I can trigger restocking alerts. The default threshold should be 10 units.
acceptance_criteria: New endpoint: GET /api/products/low-stock returns list of products with stock < threshold
Threshold is configurable via query param: GET /api/products/low-stock?threshold=20
Default threshold is 10 when no param is provided
Response is a list of Product objects (same schema as GET /api/products)
Returns empty list (not 404) when no low-stock products exist
Frontend product list highlights low-stock products (stock < 10) with a warning icon
A 'Low Stock Alert' summary badge shows in the toolbar with the count of low-stock items
